title: Crossed treble square
subtitle: A square motif with a woven X-pattern built from crossed treble pairs
excerpt: Crossed trebles work the second stitch of each pair in front of the first, locking the yarn into an X on the surface. Working these pairs in sequence across each round of a square gives a woven-looking fabric with diagonal lines running in both directions across the motif.
sourceNotes: Crossed treble construction documented in Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 3 (1888), crossed-stitch chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crossed treble crochet square in warm mustard DK cotton on a pale linen background, photographed flat from above in soft daylight. Diagonal woven X-pattern across the surface, 11 cm square.

crochet.gaugeText: Finished square measures 11 × 11 cm in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Crossed treble square
chartDefinition.caption: Crossed treble pairs (cross-tr) replace standard trebles on the sides. Corner chain-2 spaces as standard.

glossaryTerms.definition: Skip one stitch, work a treble into the next stitch, then work a second treble back into the skipped stitch, passing in front of the first treble. The two trebles cross each other on the surface.

content.text: pairs along the sides of each round, replacing the plain trebles or cluster groups of the standard granny structure. The crossing stitches pull toward each other slightly, giving a compact, dense side panel with a visible diagonal.

Work a plain 3-treble corner cluster at each corner as usual. Between corners, work crossed treble pairs: skip 1, tr in next, tr back into skipped st passing in front. Side stitches must be worked in pairs, so the stitch count per side must be even.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 10 g of DK-weight cotton. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle and scissors.

content.text: Magic ring. Ch 3 (counts as first tr). 2 tr into ring. *Ch 2, 3 tr into ring.* Rep 3 times. Ch 2. Sl st to join. (12 tr, 4 ch-2 corners.)

Sl st to corner sp. Ch 3. Into corner: 2 tr, ch 2, 3 tr. *Crossed tr pair into next 2 side tr (skip 1, tr, tr back into skipped st in front). Into next corner: 3 tr, ch 2, 3 tr.* Rep from * around. Sl st to join.
Continue with corner clusters and crossed treble pairs along sides. Side crossed-tr pairs grow by 1 pair per side per round. Fasten off after round 4.
